newsitem.title: BULGARIA: KOSTADINOVA VOTED BULGARIA'S ATHLETE OF YEAR.
newsitem.headline: KOSTADINOVA VOTED BULGARIA'S ATHLETE OF YEAR.

text.p: The Bulgarian women's Olympic champion and world high jump record holder Stefka Kostadinova was voted the country's athlete of the year for the fourth time on Friday.
Kostadinova, 30, who won her first Olympic gold in Atlanta with a clearance of 2.05 metres, is married to her coach Nikolai Petrov.
In 1995 she won her fifth world title in Gothenburg with a clearance of 2.01 metres to reclaim the title she won in Rome in 1987 on the day she set the current world record of 2.09 metres.
Kostadinova became a mother for the first time in January last year and was back to training in April 1995.
She said she would continue competing while she keeps on winning and will give up competing when she feels that the right time has come. -- Liliana Semerdjieva, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
